classification: Explicit one-time VERITAS partner-policy activation for the bilaterally agreed 2026-09-30 joint-run window
receiptImpact: Signed OracleSafetyCheck v3 and ExecutionReceipt v5 layouts, semantic profile, registry release, attester key and historical evidence are unchanged. The VERITAS-only policy v3 adds an 1800-second gate-validity exception, fixed WETH/USDC terms, the v3 selection-rule hash and a 2026-09-30 03:30 UTC end. Its partner-scoped issuance route also requires an exact dedicated API-key ID and an exact server-side window date; the generic issuer and every other partner retain existing behavior.
activationRule: Only VERITAS moves from policy v2 to immutable policy v3 after its conditional written agreement. This makes the partner policy resolvable in production after protected deployment, but does not itself enable live signing: the dedicated API-key ID and exact date must be configured, our issuer and clock must pass fresh preflight, VERITAS must pass balances/nonce/gas/RPC/clock checks and send fresh READY with an operator-host hash report during 01:55-02:00 UTC. Attempt 6 starts only at 02:00 UTC; retries require published abort and explicit VERITAS_RETRY_REQUEST. The partner route rejects requests at or after 02:50 UTC and signing at or after 02:55 UTC. The written 03:00 Bitcoin-broadcast, 03:25 attempt-end and 03:30 publication cutoffs remain external execution constraints. If any gate fails, no live run starts and a new window must be agreed in writing. The registered 600-second configuration and F12 OPEN are unchanged.
